argv:
Workspace search is misbehaving. Support has collected these reports; the product notes under docs/product/search-notes.md describe the search features.

1. A Starter customer searched for "Release 2: hotfix", the exact title of one of their issues, and was told that field-scoped search is not included in their plan. Anything with a colon in it does this, and they get no results at all.
2. An Enterprise customer typed "kind:comment flaky" in the search dialog. The dialog's hint line says it understood "searching comments", but the results are empty, although a comment containing "flaky" exists. The same happens with "in:comments flaky" and with "project:… deploy": the words are searched literally instead of narrowing the search.
3. Searching within a project never returns comments, only issues, even comments on that project's own issues. The customer ran the "rebuild search index" job for their workspace; it made no difference.
4. Searching for "100%" returns every issue in the workspace. Searching for "snake_case" also matches "snake case".
5. On a Growth workspace the command palette's results include comments, although the plan does not include searching anything but issues.
6. Ops used the "reindex this item" tool on a comment and on a project after an index clean-up. It reported success, but neither is searchable afterwards. The same tool brought an archived issue back into the results.

Expected behaviour: search behaves as the repository's documentation specifies, everywhere a search document is written or read. The documents under docs/ say how they rank.
